actual_scope: Exact paid tariff for diagonal targets over F2[W] for every finite-rank Coxeter system W, any finite number of dirty registers, free binary scalar mixing, and positive prices constant on root orbits. The concrete new test family is B_n with independent short/long prices.
scope_change_reason: The selected nonabelian-model card is refined to an all-parameter obstruction. Existing S_n and dihedral results are predecessors; increasing register count or repeating their finite searches would overlap. No native supplier is proposed.
bottleneck_link: Closes an entire noncommutative simple-reflection family as a source of cross-register paid savings. This is a formal mechanism-screening theorem; it does not improve the selected primitive or kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after a written exact theorem, independently checked B_n instances and boundary controls, or a precise counterexample; no large search or supplier expansion.
evidence: Written all-parameter proof in PROOF.md; fixed exact RESULT.json; separate non-importing independent.py; source-bound and public-CLI controls in test_package.py; AI proof/code review in REVIEW.md. No new kappa.
